name: Do I need an architect for a home renovation, or can a builder handle the design?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an architect for a home renovation, or can a builder handle the design?

acceptedAnswer.text: For significant home renovations, especially those involving structural changes, additions, or complex spatial reconfigurations, engaging an architect is highly recommended. An architect brings expertise in design, aesthetics, spatial planning, and code compliance. While some builders offer design-build services with in-house designers, an independent architect can provide a distinct perspective and detailed construction documents. Opus Builders collaborates effectively with architects or can recommend trusted design partners, ensuring a cohesive and well-executed project.
acceptedAnswer.description: For significant renovations, an architect is highly recommended for design expertise and structural changes. Some builders offer design-build, but an architect provides distinct perspective.
